en.t: Western Roman emperor Glycerius, who was not recognized by his Eastern counterpart Leo I, was forced to abdicate
en.s: Glycerius (fl. 470s) was Roman emperor of the West from 473 to 474. He served as comes domesticorum (commander of the palace guard) during the reign of Olybrius (r. 472), until Olybrius died in November 472. After a four-month interregnum, Glycerius was proclaimed as emperor in March 473 by Gundobad, the magister militum (master of soldiers) and power behind the throne.

zh.t: 西罗马皇帝格利凯里乌斯退位
zh.s: 474年6月24日，东罗马支持的尼波斯进逼后，失去军队支持的西罗马皇帝格利凯里乌斯被迫退位。尼波斯继承皇位。

en.s: The Battle of Moira, also known as the Battle of Magh Rath, was fought in the summer of AD 637 by the High King of Ireland, Domnall II, against his foster son Congal Cáech, King of Ulaid, supported by his ally Domnall Brecc, King of Dál Riata. The battle resulted in a decisive victory for the High King and his army, and Congal Cáech was killed in the fighting.
en.n: The Battle of Moira is fought between the High King of Ireland and the Kings of Ulster and Dál Riata. It is claimed to be the largest battle in the history of Ireland.

zh.s: 莫伊拉战役又称马格拉斯之战，于公元637年夏季爆发。爱尔兰至高王多姆纳尔二世与其养子、乌莱德国王孔加尔·卡赫交战；达尔里阿达国王多姆纳尔·布雷克也作为孔加尔的盟友参战。至高王及其军队取得决定性胜利，孔加尔·卡赫在战斗中阵亡。
zh.n: 莫伊拉战役中，爱尔兰至高王与阿尔斯特及达尔里阿达诸王交战。有人称这是爱尔兰历史上规模最大的战役。

en.s: In the Battle of Cedynia or Zehden, an army of Mieszko I of Poland defeated forces of Hodo or Odo I of Lusatia on 24 June 972, near the Oder river. Whether or not the battle actually took place near the modern-day town of Cedynia is disputed in modern scholarship. Mieszko I, Poland's first documented ruler based in Greater Poland, had successfully campaigned in the Cedynia area, then a West Slavic tribal territory also coveted by Holy Roman Emperor Otto I and German nobles.

zh.s: 972年6月24日，波兰的梅什科一世率军在奥得河附近击败卢萨蒂亚的霍多（奥多一世）所部。现代学界对战役是否确实发生在今天的采德尼亚附近仍有争议。梅什科一世是大波兰地区有明确记载的首位统治者；他此前已在采德尼亚一带作战。当时该地是西斯拉夫部族领地，也受到神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托一世和德国贵族觊觎。

en.s: The Battle of São Mamede (Portuguese: Batalha de São Mamede) took place on 24 June 1128 near Guimarães and is considered an important event in the process that led to the establishment of Portugal as an independent kingdom. Forces led by Afonso Henriques defeated forces led by his mother, Theresa of Portugal, and Fernão Peres de Trava.

zh.s: 圣马梅德战役（葡萄牙语：Batalha de São Mamede）于1128年6月24日在吉马良斯附近爆发，被视为葡萄牙最终建立独立王国过程中的重要事件。阿方索·恩里克斯率领的军队击败了由其母亲葡萄牙的特蕾莎和费尔南·佩雷斯·德特拉瓦率领的部队。

en.s: The Battle of Chương Dương (1285) was fought between joint Cham–Vietnamese forces, led by Prince Trần Quốc Tuấn and Duke Trần Quang Khải against the Mongol-led Yuan force under the Mongol general Sogetu in late June 1285. The battle took place at the Chương Dương port (modern-day Thường Tín District, Hanoi) on the Red River. Most of the Yuan warships were burned or sunk while Sogetu was killed in battle.

zh.s: 彰江战役发生于1285年6月下旬，交战双方是由陈国峻亲王和陈光启王爷率领的占城—越南联军，以及由蒙古将领唆都率领的元军。战斗发生在红河边的彰江港（今河内市常信县）。元军的大部分战船被焚毁或击沉，唆都也在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Bannockburn (Blàr Allt nam Bànag, often mistakenly called Blàr Allt a' Bhonnaich in Scottish Gaelic) (24 June 1314) was a significant Scottish victory in the First War of Scottish Independence, and a landmark in Scottish history. Stirling Castle, a Scots royal fortress, occupied by the English, was under siege by the Scottish army. The English king, Edward II, assembled a formidable force to relieve it. This attempt failed, and his army was defeated in a pitched battle by a smaller army commanded by the King of Scots, Robert the Bruce.

zh.s: 班诺克本战役（苏格兰盖尔语名为 Blàr Allt nam Bànag，常被误称为 Blàr Allt a' Bhonnaich）于1314年6月24日爆发，是第一次苏格兰独立战争中苏格兰的一场重要胜利，也是苏格兰历史上的重要事件。苏格兰军队围攻被英军占据的苏格兰王室要塞斯特灵城堡。英王爱德华二世率大军前来解围，但未能成功，最终在会战中被规模较小、由苏格兰国王罗伯特·布鲁斯率领的军队击败。

en.s: The Battle of Sluys (/ˈslɔɪz/; Dutch pronunciation: [slœys]), also called Battle of l'Ecluse, was a sea battle fought on 24 June 1340 as one of the opening conflicts of the Hundred Years' War between England and France. The encounter happened during the reigns of Philip VI of France and Edward III of England, in front of the town of Newmarket or Sluis (French Écluse), on the inlet between West Flanders and Zeeland. During the battle Philip's navy was almost completely destroyed, giving the English fleet complete mastery over the channel.

zh.s: 斯鲁伊斯海战（荷兰语发音：[slœys]），又称埃克吕兹海战，于1340年6月24日爆发，是英法百年战争初期的一场海战。交战双方当时分别由法国国王腓力六世和英格兰国王爱德华三世统治。战斗发生在弗兰德斯西部与泽兰之间的海湾、纽马克特（今斯鲁伊斯，又称法语 Écluse）附近。法国海军几乎全军覆没，英格兰舰队因此完全控制了英吉利海峡。

en.s: The Battle of Chioggia was a naval battle during the War of Chioggia that culminated on June 24, 1380 in the lagoon off Chioggia, Italy, between the Venetian and the Genoese fleets. The Genoese, commanded by Admiral Pietro Doria, had captured the little fishing port in August the preceding year. The port was of no consequence, but its location at an inlet to the Venetian Lagoon threatened Venice at her very doorstep. The Venetians, under Vettor Pisani and Doge Andrea Contarini, were victorious thanks in part to the fortunate arrival of Carlo Zeno at the head of a force from the east.

zh.s: 基奥贾海战是基奥贾战争中的一场海战，1380年6月24日，威尼斯舰队与热那亚舰队在意大利基奥贾附近的潟湖交战。热那亚舰队由海军上将彼得罗·多里亚指挥，于前一年8月攻占了当地的小渔港。该港口本身并不重要，但其地处威尼斯潟湖入口，直接威胁威尼斯。由维托尔·皮萨尼和总督安德烈亚·孔塔里尼率领的威尼斯军队取得胜利，部分得益于卡洛·泽诺率领的援军从东面赶到。

en.s: The siege of Tartas (31 August 1440 – 24 June 1442) in Gascony was an engagement between English and French forces in the late stages of the Hundred Years' War. It was undertaken by English forces and their Gascon subjects against Charles II of Albret, a powerful nobleman in southwestern France.

zh.s: 塔尔塔斯围城战于1440年8月31日至1442年6月24日在加斯科涅发生，是百年战争后期英法军队之间的一场战斗。英军及其加斯科涅属民发动围城，对手是法国西南部权势显赫的贵族阿尔布雷的查理二世。

en.s: Henry VIII (28 June 1491 – 28 January 1547) was King of England and Ireland from 22 April 1509 until his death in 1547. Henry was born in Greenwich as the second son of Henry VII and Elizabeth of York. His elder brother, Arthur, Prince of Wales, was heir apparent and married Catherine of Aragon, a Spanish princess.

zh.s: 亨利八世（1491年6月28日—1547年1月28日）自1509年4月22日起担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王，直至去世。他出生于格林威治，是亨利七世与约克的伊丽莎白的次子；其兄长亚瑟亲王是王位继承人，曾与西班牙公主阿拉贡的凯瑟琳结婚。

en.s: The attack on Bornholm occurred between 10 and 24 June 1566 during the Northern Seven Years' War when a Swedish fleet of 60 ships under the command of Klas Horn attempted to capture the island. Horn initially sent letters to negotiate but eventually began bombarding the island and later attempted to land, which failed. The Swedes withdrew on 24 June.

zh.s: 1566年6月10日至24日，北方七年战争期间，克拉斯·霍恩指挥一支由60艘舰船组成的瑞典舰队试图攻占博恩霍尔姆岛。霍恩起初派人送信谈判，后来开始炮击该岛，并尝试登陆，但未能成功。瑞典舰队于6月24日撤退。

en.s: The siege of Geertruidenberg was a siege of the city of Geertruidenberg that took place between 27 March and 24 June 1593 during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. Anglo-Dutch troops under the commands of Maurice of Nassau and Francis Vere laid siege to the Spanish garrisoned city. The siege was unique in that the besiegers used a hundred ships, forming a semicircle in a chain on the Mass river to form a blockade.

zh.t: 格尔特勒伊登贝赫围城战（1593年）
zh.s: 格尔特勒伊登贝赫围城战发生于1593年3月27日至6月24日，属于八十年战争和英西战争的一部分。拿骚的莫里斯和弗朗西斯·维尔指挥英荷联军围攻由西班牙驻军守卫的城市。围城的一大特点是，围城方动用了100艘船，在马斯河上排成半圆形船链，封锁了城市。

en.s: The Famagusta expedition was launched by the Tuscans in an attempt to reconquer the island of Cyprus from the Ottomans. The Tuscans attacked the city of Famagusta, but the expedition ended in failure.

en.s: The Battle of Tsaryovo-Zaymishche took place on June 23–24, 1610, during the Polish–Muscovite War (1605–18). Forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth were commanded by Hetman of Poland, Stanislaw Zolkiewski, while Russians were led by Grigory Valuyev. The battle ended in decisive Polish victory.

zh.s: 察廖沃—扎伊米谢战役于1610年6月23日至24日在波兰—莫斯科战争（1605—1618年）期间爆发。波兰—立陶宛联邦军由波兰大盖特曼斯坦尼斯瓦夫·若乌凯夫斯基指挥，俄军则由格里戈里·瓦卢耶夫率领。战役以波兰军队决定性胜利告终。

en.s: The Battle of Gibraltar took place 24 June 1618 at the Strait of Gibraltar. It took place during the Venetian-Habsburg conflicts, when Spanish forces tried to block a Venetian and Dutch fleet from passing through the Strait, engaging only the Venetians in battle. The battle was ultimately inconclusive when the Spanish received order to let them pass.

zh.s: 直布罗陀海战于1618年6月24日在直布罗陀海峡爆发，发生在威尼斯—哈布斯堡冲突期间。西班牙军队试图阻止威尼斯和荷兰舰队通过海峡，并与其中的威尼斯舰只交战。西班牙后来接到放行命令，战斗最终没有分出胜负。

en.s: The siege of Saint-Jean-d'Angély (French: siège de Saint-Jean-d'Angély) was a siege (military blockade), accomplished by the young French king Louis XIII in 1621, against the Protestant stronghold of Saint-Jean-d'Angély led by Rohan's brother Benjamin de Rohan, duc de Soubise. Saint-Jean-d'Angély was a strategic city controlling the approach to the Huguenot stronghold of La Rochelle. The city was captured after only 26 days, on 24 June 1621.

zh.s: 1621年，法国国王路易十三亲自指挥围攻圣让当热利。这座新教据点由罗昂公爵之弟、苏比斯公爵本雅曼·德·罗昂守卫。圣让当热利是通往胡格诺派据点拉罗谢尔的战略要地。围城持续26天，该城于1621年6月24日被攻占。

en.s: The Battle of Macau in 1622 was a conflict of the Dutch–Portuguese War fought in the Portuguese settlement of Macau, in southeastern China. The Portuguese, outnumbered and without adequate fortification, managed to repel the Dutch in a much-celebrated victory on 24 June after a three-day battle. The battle is the only major engagement that was fought primarily between two European powers on the Chinese mainland.
en.n: Battle of Macau: The Dutch make a failed attempt to capture Macau.

zh.s: 1622年澳门战役是荷葡战争的一场冲突，发生在中国东南部的葡萄牙人聚居地澳门。葡萄牙军队人数较少，防御工事也不充分，但经过三天战斗，于6月24日击退荷兰军队，取得一场广受称颂的胜利。这是中国大陆上欧洲列强之间唯一一场主要战事。
zh.n: 澳门战役：荷兰人试图攻占澳门，但未能成功。

en.s: The siege of Dunkirk in 1658 was a military operation by France and the Commonwealth of England intended to capture the fortified port city of Dunkirk, Spain's greatest privateering base, from a Spanish garrison strengthened with English Royalists and French Fronduers. Dunkirk (Dutch for 'Church in the dunes') was a strategic port on the southern coast of the English Channel in the Spanish Netherlands that had often been a point of contention previously and had changed hands a number of times.

en.s: The Treaty of Adrianople, also called the Treaty of Edirne, was signed on 24 June 1713 between the Ottoman Empire and the Tsardom of Russia and confirmed the Treaty of the Pruth of 1711, which had ended the Pruth River Campaign (1710–1711).

zh.s: 阿德里安堡条约又称埃迪尔内条约，于1713年6月24日在奥斯曼帝国与俄罗斯沙皇国之间签署，并确认了1711年结束普鲁特河战役的《普鲁特条约》。

en.t: The Premier Grand Lodge of England is founded in London, the first Masonic Grand Lodge in the world (now the United Grand Lodge of England)
en.s: The organisation now known as the Premier Grand Lodge of England was founded on 24 June 1717 as the Grand Lodge of London and Westminster. Originally concerned with the practice of Freemasonry in London and Westminster, it soon became known as the Grand Lodge of England.

zh.t: 世界首个共济会总会在伦敦成立
zh.s: 如今称为英格兰首家总会（Premier Grand Lodge of England）的组织于1717年6月24日在伦敦成立，当时名为伦敦与威斯敏斯特总会。该组织最初负责伦敦和威斯敏斯特的共济会事务，后来逐渐被称为英格兰总会。

en.s: The siege of Ypres took place between 15 and 24 June 1744 during the War of the Austrian Succession. A French army under the nominal command of King Louis XV and operational command of the Duke of Noailles, took the city from its Dutch garrison after a short siege.

zh.s: 伊普尔围城战于1744年6月15日至24日在奥地利王位继承战争期间进行。路易十五名义上统率、诺阿耶公爵实际指挥的法军，仅用较短时间便从荷兰守军手中夺取该城。

en.s: The second Durrani Campaign to Khorasan took place between 1754–1755. Ahmad Shah Durrani launched the campaign to avenge his defeat in the first campaign of Khorasan against the rulers of Nishapur, intending to advance on Mashhad and then Nishapur to bring the cities to submission. The campaign began in the summer of 1754, with Afghan forces defeating the governor of Tabas's army and raiding the countryside while forcing cities into submission.

zh.s: 1754年至1755年，艾哈迈德沙阿·杜兰尼率军再次进攻呼罗珊，目标包括马什哈德和内沙布尔。原文资料框将1755年6月24日列为战役结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Wilhelmsthal (sometimes written as the Battle of Wilhelmstadt) was fought on 24 June 1762 during the Seven Years' War between on one side the allied forces of British, Prussian, Hanover, Brunswick and Hessian troops under the command of the Duke of Brunswick against the French. Once again, the French threatened Hanover, so the Allies manoeuvered around the French, surrounded the invasion force, and forced them to retreat. It was the last major action fought by Brunswick's force before the Peace of Paris brought an end to the war.

zh.s: 威廉斯塔尔战役（有时也写作威廉施塔特战役）于1762年6月24日在七年战争期间爆发。布伦瑞克公爵指挥英国、普鲁士、汉诺威、不伦瑞克和黑森联军对抗法国军队。法国再次威胁汉诺威，联军于是迂回包围法军入侵部队，迫使其撤退。这是《巴黎条约》结束战争前，布伦瑞克部队参加的最后一场重要战斗。

en.s: The Great Siege of Gibraltar was an unsuccessful attempt by Spain and France to capture Gibraltar from Britain during the American Revolutionary War. It was the largest battle in the war by number of combatants. On 16 June 1779, Spain entered the war on the side of France with the primary war aim of capturing Gibraltar from the British.
en.n: American Revolutionary War: The Great Siege of Gibraltar begins.

zh.s: 1779年6月24日，美国独立战争期间，西班牙和法国开始围攻英国控制的直布罗陀。围攻持续至1783年，最终未能夺城。
zh.n: 美国独立战争期间，直布罗陀大围攻开始。

en.s: The Constitution of 24 June 1793 (French: Acte constitutionnel du 24 juin 1793), also known as the Constitution of the Year I, or The Montagnard Constitution (French: Constitution montagnarde), was the constitution instated by the Montagnards and by popular referendum under the First Republic during the French Revolution. Drafted by the Committee of Public Safety which was enlarged with the purpose of producing it, the text was presented to the National Convention on 10 June and subsequently accepted by that body on 24 June 1793. The constitution was then ratified by a popular referendum employing universal male suffrage, following approval by 1,784,377 out of approximately 1,800,000 voters.

zh.s: 1793年6月24日宪法（法语：Acte constitutionnel du 24 juin 1793）也称共和元年宪法或山岳派宪法，是法国大革命期间由山岳派制定、并经全民公投的第一共和国宪法。公共安全委员会为起草宪法而扩充，文本于6月10日提交国民公会，并于1793年6月24日获国民公会通过。随后，宪法经男性普选公投批准，约180万名选民中有1,784,377人投赞成票。

en.s: The siege of Bellegarde commenced on 23 May 1793 and ended on 24 June 1793 when Colonel Boisbrulé's French garrison surrendered the Fort de Bellegarde to a Spanish army under the command of Antonio Ricardos. The capture of the fort gave Spain control of an important road through the Pyrenees. The siege took place during the War of the Pyrenees, part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 贝勒加德围城战于1793年5月23日开始，6月24日结束。法国守军由布瓦布吕莱上校指挥，最终向安东尼奥·里卡多斯率领的西班牙军队投降。西班牙攻占要塞后控制了比利牛斯山脉的一条重要道路。这场围城战发生在比利牛斯战争期间，属于法国大革命战争的一部分。

en.s: The Action of 24 June 1795 was a minor naval engagement fought in the Western Basin of the Mediterranean Sea on 24 June 1795 during the French Revolutionary Wars. During 1795 the Royal Navy and French Navy Mediterranean Fleets were vying for supremacy in the region, the French operating from the fortified port of Toulon and the British from the allied Spanish base of Port Mahon on Minorca. A minor British victory at the Battle of Genoa in March had not resolved the conflict, both sides suffering damage.

zh.s: 1795年6月24日海战是法国大革命战争期间在地中海西部海盆发生的一场小规模海战。1795年，英国皇家海军与法国海军地中海舰队争夺该地区的制海权：法国舰队以设防港口土伦为基地，英国舰队则驻扎在盟友西班牙位于梅诺卡岛的马翁港。英国在3月的热那亚海战中小胜，但未能解决这场争夺，双方舰队都遭受了损失。

en.s: During the Battle of Kehl (or Crossing near Kehl; 23–24 June 1796), a Republican French force under the direction of Jean Charles Abbatucci mounted an amphibious crossing of the Rhine River against a defending force of soldiers from the Swabian Circle. In this action of the War of the First Coalition, the French drove the Swabians from their positions in Kehl and subsequently controlled the bridgehead on both sides of the Rhine.

zh.s: 凯尔战役又称凯尔附近渡河行动，于1796年6月23日至24日进行。让·夏尔·阿巴图奇指挥共和派法军渡过莱茵河，进攻施瓦本地区的守军。这场第一次反法同盟战争中的战斗以法军击退施瓦本军队告终，法军随后控制了莱茵河两岸的桥头堡。

en.s: The Action of 24 June 1801 was a minor naval engagement during the French Revolutionary Wars. A British ship of the line, HMS Swiftsure under Captain Benjamin Hallowell was passing westwards through the Southern Mediterranean near Cape Derna when it encountered a much larger French squadron under Contre-Amiral Honoré Ganteaume that was also returning westwards after a failed attempt to reinforce the besieged French garrison in Egypt. Although Hallowell immediately recognised the danger his vessel was in and turned to flee, the French ships were much faster and soon closed with his ship.

zh.s: 1801年6月24日，法国大革命战争期间发生了一场小规模海战。英国战列舰“迅捷”号由本杰明·哈洛韦尔舰长指挥，正沿地中海南部向西航行，经过德尔纳海角附近时，遇上了同样向西返航的法国分舰队。该分舰队由海军少将奥诺雷·甘托姆指挥，此前曾试图增援被围困在埃及的法军驻军，但未能成功。哈洛韦尔很快意识到己方处境危险并试图逃离，但法国舰只速度更快，很快追上了他的舰船。

en.s: The Battle of Nykarleby was fought between Sweden and the Russian Empire during the Finnish War of 1808–1809. When Carl Johan Adlercreutz continued his summer offensive, he saw an excellent opportunity to encircle the Russian main army at the town of Nykarleby. The Swedish offensive began on Midsummer's Eve, but the Russian forces had already evacuated the city and pulled back to Vaasa, where another Swedish force, commanded by Johan Bergenstråhle was landing.

zh.s: 芬兰战争期间，瑞典与俄罗斯帝国在尼卡尔勒比交战。卡尔·约翰·阿德勒克罗伊茨继续夏季攻势时，发现有机会包围驻扎在尼卡尔勒比镇的俄军主力。瑞典军于仲夏节前夕开始进攻，但俄军已撤出该城，退往瓦萨；另一支由约翰·伯恩斯特雷勒指挥的瑞典部队正在那里登陆。

en.s: The French invasion of Russia, known in Russia as the Patriotic War of 1812 (Russian: Отечественная война 1812 года, Otechestvennaya Voyna 1812 Goda) and in France as the Russian Campaign (French: Campagne de Russie), began on 24 June 1812 when Napoleon's Grande Armée crossed the Neman River in an attempt to engage and defeat the Russian army. Napoleon hoped to compel Tsar Alexander I of Russia to cease trading with British merchants through proxies in an effort to pressure the United Kingdom to sue for peace. The official political aim of the campaign was to liberate Poland from the threat of Russia.

zh.s: 法国入侵俄罗斯在俄罗斯被称为1812年卫国战争，在法国被称为俄罗斯远征。1812年6月24日，拿破仑的大军越过涅曼河，试图与俄军交战并将其击败。拿破仑希望迫使俄国沙皇亚历山大一世停止通过中间商与英国商人贸易，以此向英国施压、促使其求和。这场战役的官方政治目标是让波兰摆脱俄罗斯的威胁。

en.s: The Battle of Beaver Dams took place on 24 June 1813, during the War of 1812. A column of troops from the United States Army marched from Fort George and attempted to surprise a British outpost at Beaver Dams, billeting themselves overnight in the village of Queenston, Ontario.

zh.s: 比弗水坝战役于1813年6月24日在1812年战争期间爆发。美国陆军一支部队从乔治堡出发，试图突袭英军设在比弗水坝的前哨，并在安大略省昆士顿村过夜。

en.s: After their defeat at the Battle of Waterloo on 18 June 1815, the French Army of the North, under the command of Napoleon Bonaparte retreated in disarray back towards France. As agreed by the two Seventh Coalition commanders in chief, the Duke of Wellington, commander of the Anglo-allied army, and Prince Blücher, commander of the Prussian army, the French were to be closely pursued by units of the Prussian cavalry.

zh.s: 1815年6月18日滑铁卢战役战败后，拿破仑·波拿巴指挥的北方军团仓皇撤回法国。按第七次反法同盟两位总司令的约定，指挥英军及盟军的威灵顿公爵和指挥普鲁士军队的布吕歇尔亲王决定由普鲁士骑兵部队紧追法军。

en.s: The Second Battle of Carabobo (Spanish: Batalla de Carabobo), on 24 June 1821, was fought between independence fighters, led by Venezuelan General Simón Bolívar, and the Royalist forces, led by Spanish Field Marshal Miguel de la Torre. Bolívar's decisive victory at Carabobo led to the independence of Venezuela and establishment of the Republic of Gran Colombia.

zh.s: 卡拉沃沃第二次战役于1821年6月24日爆发。西蒙·玻利瓦尔将军率领独立军，对抗西班牙王家陆军元帅米格尔·德拉托雷指挥的保王军。玻利瓦尔在卡拉沃沃取得决定性胜利，推动委内瑞拉独立，并促成大哥伦比亚共和国的建立。

en.s: The Battle of Mega Spilaio of Achaia was a military episode of the Greek War of Independence, an event that took place during the campaign of Ibrahim of Egypt against the Christian populations of the Peloponnese in the summer of 1827 - a critical year for the revolution. The outcome of the battle was positive for Greek weapons and led to the withdrawal of the Turkish-Egyptian troops from the wider area of Kalavryta.

zh.s: 1827年6月24日，希腊独立战争期间，易卜拉欣帕夏率约6000名奥斯曼—埃及士兵进攻伯罗奔尼撒半岛的大洞穴修道院。希腊守军抵挡进攻，迫使对方撤出卡拉夫里塔一带。

en.s: The Siege of Anapa was a key military operation during both the Russo-Circassian War and the Russo-Turkish War. Taking place between May 14 and June 24, 1828, it marked a significant Russian victory, as the strategic Ottoman fortress of Anapa fell to Russian forces after weeks of intense fighting. The capture of Anapa weakened Ottoman influence in the north-eastern Black Sea region and disrupted Circassian coordination against Russian expansion.

zh.s: 阿纳帕围城战是俄切尔克斯战争和俄土战争期间的一次重要军事行动，持续时间为1828年5月14日至6月24日。俄军经过数周激战攻下奥斯曼帝国的战略要塞阿纳帕，取得重大胜利。攻占阿纳帕削弱了奥斯曼帝国在黑海东北部的影响力，也打乱了切尔克斯人抵抗俄国扩张的协调行动。

en.s: The Battle of Apple River Fort, occurred on the late afternoon of June 24, 1832 at the Apple River Fort, near present-day Elizabeth, Illinois, when Black Hawk and 200 of his "British Band" of Sauk and Fox were surprised by a group of four messengers en route from Galena, Illinois. One of the couriers was wounded in the thigh as the riders quickly made for the protection of the nearby stockade.

zh.s: 1832年6月24日傍晚，黑鹰率约200名索克族和福克斯族“英国队”成员来到今伊利诺伊州伊丽莎白附近的苹果河堡，意外遇到四名从加利纳赶来的信使。一名信使大腿受伤，四人随即骑马躲进附近的木栅堡垒。

en.s: The Battle of Montenegro, also called the Battle of Cuyambuyo, was fought on 24 June 1838 during the war between Argentina and the Peru–Bolivian Confederation.The invading Argentine army was defeated by a force led by Otto Philipp Braun supported by Francisco Burdett O'Connor, settling the location of Bolivia's southwestern border.

zh.s: 黑山战役又称库扬布约战役，于1838年6月24日在阿根廷与秘鲁—玻利维亚邦联之间的战争中爆发。奥托·菲利普·布劳恩率领的部队在弗朗西斯科·伯德特·奥康纳协助下击败入侵的阿根廷军队，并由此确定了玻利维亚西南部边界的位置。

en.s: The Battle of Nezib (Arabic: معركة نزب) (present-day Nizip in south-central modern Turkey) was fought on 24 June 1839 between the forces of the quasi-autonomous province of Ottoman Egypt and those of the Ottoman Empire. The Egyptians were led by Ibrahim Pasha, with Soliman Pasha al-Faransawi (a former French officer who had converted to Islam) commanding the right flank of the Egyptian army.

en.s: The Battle of Olómpali was fought on June 24, 1846, between a rebel group supporting an independent California Republic and a Mexican army force under the command of Joaquín de la Torre. It was the only battle of the Bear Flag Revolt. The encounter took place in present-day Marin County, California at a site that is now part of the Olompali State Historic Park.

zh.s: 奥隆帕利战役于1846年6月24日爆发，交战双方是支持建立独立加利福尼亚共和国的起义者，以及由华金·德拉托雷指挥的墨西哥军队。这是熊旗起义期间唯一一场战斗。战斗发生在今天加利福尼亚州马林县一带，该地点现属于奥隆帕利州立历史公园。

en.s: The Battle of Solferino (referred to in Italy as the Battle of Solferino and San Martino) on 24 June 1859 resulted in the victory of the allied French Army under Napoleon III and Sardinian Army under Victor Emmanuel II (together known as the Franco-Sardinian Alliance) against the Austrian Army under Emperor Franz Joseph I. It was the last major battle in world history where all the armies were under the personal command of their monarchs. Perhaps 300,000 soldiers fought in the important battle, the largest since the Battle of Leipzig in 1813.

zh.s: 索尔费里诺战役（在意大利也称索尔费里诺和圣马蒂诺战役）于1859年6月24日爆发。拿破仑三世统率的法国军队与维托里奥·埃马努埃莱二世统率的撒丁军队组成法撒联盟，击败了弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世皇帝统率的奥地利军队。这是世界历史上最后一场所有参战军队都由君主亲自指挥的重大战役。约有30万士兵参战，规模是1813年莱比锡战役以来最大的一场。

en.s: The Battle of Hoover's Gap (24 June 1863) was the principal battle in the Tullahoma Campaign of the American Civil War, in which Union General William S. Rosecrans drove General Braxton Bragg’s Confederates out of Central Tennessee. Rosecrans’ feigned move on the western end of the Confederate line had left the eastern mountain passes lightly defended, and Colonel John T. Wilder's mounted infantry achieved total surprise when they attacked Hoover's Gap. Success was attributed both to Rosecrans’ brilliant deception tactics and the high morale of Wilder’s ‘Lightning Brigade’, equipped with the new Spencer repeating rifle, which totally disoriented the enemy.

zh.s: 胡佛峡谷战役于1863年6月24日爆发，是美国内战中图拉霍马战役行动的主要战斗。在这场战役中，联邦军威廉·S·罗斯克兰斯将军迫使布拉克斯顿·布拉格将军的邦联军撤出田纳西州中部。罗斯克兰斯佯攻邦联防线西端，使东侧山口防守薄弱。约翰·T·怀尔德上校率骑马步兵突袭胡佛峡谷，打了对方一个措手不及。罗斯克兰斯的迷惑战术和怀尔德“闪电旅”的高昂士气都被认为是取胜原因；该部队装备的新型斯宾塞连发步枪令敌军阵脚大乱。

en.s: The Battle of Liberty Gap was fought during the Tullahoma Campaign of the American Civil War. The battle was an early instance of mounted infantry using Spencer repeating rifles during the war similar to the concurrent battle of Hoover's Gap.

en.s: The Battle of Custoza took place on the 24 June 1866 during the Third Italian War of Independence in the Italian unification process. The Austrian Imperial army, joined by the Venetian Army, jointly commanded by Archduke Albrecht of Habsburg, defeated the Italian army, led by Alfonso Ferrero La Marmora.

en.s: "O Canada" (French: "Ô Canada") is the national anthem of Canada. The song was originally commissioned by Lieutenant Governor of Quebec Théodore Robitaille for the 1880 Saint-Jean-Baptiste Day ceremony; Calixa Lavallée composed the music, after which French-language words were written by the poet and judge Sir Adolphe-Basile Routhier. The original French lyrics were translated to English in 1906.

en.s: On 24 June 1894, French President Sadi Carnot was assassinated by Italian anarchist Sante Geronimo Caserio in Lyon, France. A part of the Ère des attentats anarchist terrorist campaign (1892–1894), it led to a historic crackdown on French anarchist activities. Carnot was one of the main supporters of the lois scélérates ('villainous laws'), which aimed to break up anarchist activities during the Ère des attentats, as well as the repression targeting them in early 1894.

zh.s: 1894年6月24日，法国总统萨迪·卡诺在法国里昂遭意大利无政府主义者桑特·杰罗尼莫·卡塞里奥刺杀身亡。这起事件属于1892至1894年的无政府主义恐怖袭击浪潮，促使法国政府大规模打击无政府主义活动。卡诺是《恶法》的主要支持者之一。这些法律旨在打击无政府主义活动，1894年初政府也曾对相关活动进行镇压。

en.s: The 1893 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 6th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1893 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.s: The Battle of Las Guasimas of June 24, 1898 was a Spanish rearguard action by Major General Antero Rubín against advancing columns led by Major General "Fighting Joe" Wheeler and the first land engagement of the Spanish–American War. en.s: The Siamese revolution of 1932 or the Siamese coup d'état of 1932 (Thai: การปฏิวัติสยาม พ.ศ. 2475 or การเปลี่ยนแปลงการปกครองสยาม พ.ศ. 2475) was a crucial turning point in 20th-century Thai history. The revolution, a coup d'état, was a nearly bloodless transition on 24 June 1932, which changed the system of government in Siam from an absolute monarchy to a constitutional monarchy. The "revolution" was brought about by a comparatively small group of military and civilians, who formed Siam's first political party, the Khana Ratsadon (Peoples' Party). It ended 150 years of absolutism under the Chakri Dynasty and almost 700 years of absolute rule of kings over Thai history.

en.s: The Partisan Long March was the redeployment of Josip Broz Tito's Partisan Supreme Headquarters and the major fighting elements of the Yugoslav Partisans across the Independent State of Croatia (Serbo-Croatian: Nezavisna Država Hrvatska, NDH), from south-eastern to north-western Bosnia that commenced in late June 1942. The march followed the first large-scale joint German-Italian counter-insurgency operation in the NDH, Operation Trio, and the combined Italian-Montenegrin Chetnik offensive in Montenegro and eastern Herzegovina. The majority of the units of the National Liberation Army (1st and 2nd Proletarian, 3rd Sandžak and 4th Montenegrin Brigades) and the Supreme Headquarters of the NOV and POJ set out from the territory of Mt Zelengora on June 24, 1942, for western Bosnia.

zh.s: 1972年6月24日，临时爱尔兰共和军在北爱尔兰邓吉文附近乡间的克拉巴基地区引爆一枚简易地雷，炸死一辆路虎车内的三名英国陆军士兵。这是爱尔兰共和军在20世纪70年代于乡村地区发动的多起地雷袭击之一。

en.s: The UpStairs Lounge arson attack took place on June 24, 1973 at a gay bar located on the second floor of the three-story building at 141 Chartres Street in the French Quarter of New Orleans, Louisiana, in the United States. Thirty-two people died as a result of fire or smoke inhalation. The official cause is still listed as "undetermined origin". The most likely suspect, a gay man who had been thrown out of the bar earlier in the day, was never charged. Until the 2016 Orlando nightclub shooting, it was the deadliest known attack on a gay club in U.S. history.

zh.s: 1973年6月24日，美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良法国区一栋三层建筑的二楼同性恋酒吧“楼上酒廊”遭人纵火，造成32人死于火灾或吸入浓烟。官方至今将起火原因列为“无法确定”。最可能的嫌疑人是一名当天早些时候被酒吧赶走的同性恋男子，但他从未受到起诉。直到2016年奥兰多夜店枪击案发生前，这是美国历史上已知死亡人数最多的同性恋俱乐部袭击事件。

en.s: Eastern Air Lines Flight 66 was a regularly scheduled flight from New Orleans to New York City that crashed on June 24, 1975, when a Boeing 727-225 went on approach to New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport, killing 113 of the 124 people on board. The accident was determined to be caused by wind shear stemming from a microburst, but the failure of the airport and the flight crew to recognize the severe weather hazard was also a contributing factor.

zh.s: 东方航空66号班机原定从新奥尔良飞往纽约市。1975年6月24日，波音727-225客机在纽约约翰·F·肯尼迪国际机场进场时坠毁，机上124人中113人遇难。调查认定，事故由微下击暴流引发的风切变造成；机场和机组人员未能及时识别严重天气风险，也是事故的促成因素。

en.t: The Humber Bridge opens to traffic, connecting Yorkshire and Lincolnshire. It remained the world's longest bridge span for 17 years
en.s: The Humber Bridge is a 2.22-kilometre (2,430-yard; 7,300-foot; 1.38-mile) single-span road suspension bridge near Kingston upon Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire, England. When it opened to traffic on 24 June 1981, it was the longest of its type in the world; the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge surpassed it in 1998, and it became the fourteenth-longest by 2025.

zh.t: 亨伯桥通车，连接约克郡与林肯郡
zh.s: 亨伯桥是一座位于英格兰东约克郡赫尔河畔金斯顿附近的单跨公路悬索桥，全长2.22公里（2430码、7300英尺、1.38英里）。该桥于1981年6月24日通车，此后17年一直是世界上同类型桥梁中跨度最长的一座。1998年，明石海峡大桥超过它；截至2025年，亨伯桥的跨度排名世界第14。

en.s: British Airways Flight 009, sometimes referred to by its callsign SPEEDBIRD 9 or as the Jakarta incident, was a scheduled British Airways flight from London Heathrow to Auckland, with stops in Bombay, Kuala Lumpur, Perth and Melbourne. On 24 June 1982, the route was flown by City of Edinburgh, a Boeing 747-236B registered as G-BDXH.

en.s: The 1984 Soviet Cup final was a football match that took place at the Lenin's Central Stadium, Moscow on June 24, 1984. The match was the 43rd Soviet Cup final and it was contested by Dynamo Moscow and Zenit Leningrad. After a goalless 90 minutes, Valeriy Gazzaev and Aleksandr Borodyuk scored in extra time as Dynamo Moscow won 2–0 for their sixth Soviet Cup title.

zh.s: 1984年苏联杯决赛于1984年6月24日在莫斯科列宁中央体育场举行，是第43届苏联杯决赛。参赛双方是莫斯科迪纳摩和列宁格勒泽尼特。双方在90分钟内战成0比0，瓦列里·加扎耶夫和亚历山大·博罗久克在加时赛进球，莫斯科迪纳摩最终以2比0获胜，第六次夺得苏联杯。

en.s: The 1985 election of the President of the Italian Republic was held on June 24, 1985. As a second-level, indirect election, only Members of Parliament and regional deputies were entitled to vote. Francesco Cossiga was elected head of state of the Italian Republic, a role of representation of national unity and guarantee that Italian politics comply with the Constitution, in the framework of a parliamentary system.

zh.s: 意大利共和国总统选举于1985年6月24日举行。这是间接选举，只有议会议员和大区代表有投票权。弗朗切斯科·科西加当选意大利总统。总统负责代表国家团结，并确保意大利政治符合宪法；意大利实行议会制。

en.s: The 1989 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1988–89 DFB-Pokal, the 46th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 24 June 1989 at the Olympiastadion in West Berlin. Borussia Dortmund won the match 4–1 against Werder Bremen to claim their second cup title, qualifying for the 1989–90 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 1989 DFB-Supercup.

zh.s: 1989年德国足协杯决赛决出了1988—89赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第46个赛季。决赛于1989年6月24日在西柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。多特蒙德以4比1击败云达不来梅，第二次夺得杯赛冠军，并获得1989—90赛季欧洲优胜者杯及1989年德国超级杯参赛资格。

en.t: 1994 Fairchild Air Force Base B-52 crash
en.s: On Friday, 24 June 1994, a United States Air Force (USAF) Boeing B-52 Stratofortress crashed at Fairchild Air Force Base, Washington, United States, after the pilot, Lt Col Arthur "Bud" Holland, maneuvered the bomber beyond its operational limits and lost control. The aircraft stalled, fell to the ground and exploded, killing Holland and the other three USAF officers aboard. The crash was captured on video and was shown repeatedly on news broadcasts throughout the world. The subsequent investigation concluded that the crash was attributable primarily to three factors: Holland's personality and behavior, USAF leaders' delayed or inadequate reactions to earlier incidents involving Holland, and the sequence of events during the aircraft's final flight.

zh.t: 1994年费尔柴尔德空军基地B-52坠机事故
zh.s: 1994年6月24日星期五，美国空军一架波音B-52“同温层堡垒”轰炸机在华盛顿州费尔柴尔德空军基地坠毁。飞行员、空军中校阿瑟·“巴德”·霍兰德操纵飞机超出运行限制，导致失控。飞机失速坠地并爆炸，霍兰德及机上另外三名空军军官全部遇难。事故被拍下，并在世界各地的新闻节目中反复播出。后续调查认为，事故主要由三方面因素造成：霍兰德的性格和行为、空军领导层对他此前相关事件反应迟缓或不足，以及飞机最后一次飞行过程中的一系列情况。

en.s: Hostile City Showdown (1994) was the first Hostile City Showdown professional wrestling event produced by Eastern Championship Wrestling (ECW). It took place on June 24, 1994 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. The main event of Hostile City Showdown was a heavily promoted "dream match" between the hardcore wrestlers Cactus Jack and Sabu.

en.s: The 1995 Copa del Rey final was the 93rd final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Santiago Bernabéu Stadium in Madrid on 24 June 1995. The match was suspended after 79 minutes due to heavy rain and hail, and was resumed on 27 June 1995. The match was won by Deportivo de La Coruña, who beat Valencia CF 2–1 for their first cup title.

zh.s: 1995年西班牙国王杯决赛是该赛事第93届决赛。比赛于1995年6月24日在马德里的圣地亚哥·伯纳乌球场举行。由于暴雨和冰雹，比赛在第79分钟暂停，并于1995年6月27日继续进行。拉科鲁尼亚以2比1击败瓦伦西亚，首次赢得国王杯冠军。

zh.s: 1995年德国足协杯决赛决出1994—95赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第52个赛季。决赛于1995年6月24日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。门兴格拉德巴赫以3比0击败沃尔夫斯堡，第三次夺得杯赛冠军，并获得1995—96赛季欧洲优胜者杯和1995年德国超级杯的参赛资格。

en.s: King of the Ring (2001) was the ninth annual King of the Ring professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It was presented by Mars' Combos and took place on June 24, 2001, at the Continental Airlines Arena in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The main event was a Triple threat match, a match involving three competitors, for the WWF Championship. Stone Cold Steve Austin defeated Chris Benoit and Chris Jericho to retain the title. The undercard featured the 2001 King of the Ring tournament won by Edge. This was also the last King of the Ring under the WWF banner.

zh.s: 2001年“擂台之王”大赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF）举办的第九届年度同名付费电视赛事，由玛氏 Combos 零食赞助，于2001年6月24日在新泽西州东卢瑟福的大陆航空体育馆举行。主赛是WWF冠军三方赛，史蒂夫·奥斯汀击败克里斯·班瓦和克里斯·杰里科，保住冠军头衔。赛事还包括2001年“擂台之王”锦标赛，最终由艾吉夺冠。这也是该赛事最后一次以WWF名义举办。

en.s: The Sicilian regional election of 2001 was held on 24 June 2001. For the first time the president of Region was elected directly by the citizens. The election was competed by three competitors: Salvatore Cuffaro, House of Freedoms candidate; Leoluca Orlando, candidate of The Olive Tree; and Sergio D'Antoni, leader of European Democracy. Cuffaro won by a landslide.

zh.s: 西西里大区选举于2001年6月24日举行。这是该大区首次由选民直接选举大区主席。共有三名候选人参选：自由之家联盟候选人萨尔瓦托雷·库法罗、橄榄树联盟候选人莱奥卢卡·奥兰多，以及欧洲民主党领袖塞尔吉奥·达安托尼。库法罗以明显优势胜出。

en.s: The Igandu train disaster occurred during the early morning of June 24, 2002, in Tanzania. It is one of the worst rail accidents in African history. A passenger train with over 1,200 people on board rolled backwards down a hill into a slow-moving goods train, killing 281. The cause was brake failure, with unproven claims of sabotage.

zh.s: 2002年6月24日清晨，坦桑尼亚伊甘杜发生严重铁路事故，是非洲铁路史上最严重的事故之一。一列载有1,200多人的客运列车失控倒退下坡，撞上一列缓慢行驶的货运列车，造成281人死亡。事故由制动器故障引起；有关蓄意破坏的说法尚未得到证实。

en.s: The Battle of Majar al-Kabir was the result of growing distrust between the British military and local inhabitants of south-eastern Iraq over house searches and confiscation of personal weapons that locals felt were crucial for their self-protection. Despite a signed agreement between local people and British forces stating that the British would not enter the town, the 1st Battalion, Parachute Regiment started patrolling in the town of Majar al-Kabir on 24 June 2003, the day after the agreement was signed.

zh.s: 围绕入户搜查和收缴私人武器的问题，英国军方与伊拉克东南部居民之间的不信任日益加深，当地居民认为这些武器对自卫至关重要。双方曾签署协议，约定英军不进入该镇，但协议签署次日，即2003年6月24日，英国伞兵团第一营开始在马贾尔·卡比尔镇巡逻。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Iran 17 June 2005, with a second round run-off on 24 June. Mohammad Khatami, the outgoing president of Iran, stepped down on 2 August 2005, after serving his maximum two consecutive four-year terms according to the Islamic republic's constitution. As no candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round, a run-off was held between the top two candidates, former president (1989–1997) Akbar Rafsanjanī and Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, the hardline mayor of Tehran.

en.s: Operation Bull Run was a 48-hour-long military operation during the occupation of Iraq that began on 24 June 2007 in Al Dura'iya. A joint operation between the US Army's 1st Battalion, 15th Infantry of the 3rd Heavy Brigade and the Iraqi National Police and Iraqi Army, the operation netted four to seven captured insurgents and two killed. Launched from Forward Operating Base Hammer, it formed part of Operation Marne Torch, clearing insurgent sanctuaries to the southeast of Baghdad, and in addition to the insurgents killed and captured, it liberated three separate caches of artillery rounds, mortars, firearms and ammunition, along with propaganda and cell phones.

zh.s: “公牛奔袭行动”是伊拉克占领时期的一次军事行动，2007年6月24日在杜赖耶开始，持续48小时。行动由美国陆军第3重型旅第15步兵团第1营、伊拉克国家警察和伊拉克陆军联合实施，抓获4至7名叛乱分子，击毙2人。部队从“锤子”前进基地出发，行动属于“马恩火炬行动”的一部分，目标是清剿巴格达东南部的叛乱分子藏身处。行动还缴获了三处弹药和武器库，内有炮弹、迫击炮、枪支、弹药、宣传品和手机。

en.s: Vengeance: Night of Champions was the seventh annual professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) within its Vengeance/Night of Champions chronology. It featured talent from the Raw, SmackDown!, and ECW brands. The event was sponsored by RAW Attitude Energy Drink and took place on June 24, 2007, at the Toyota Center in Houston, Texas. Every match on the card was contested for a championship; two were won and seven were retained. This event was notable for being on the weekend of the Chris Benoit double-murder and suicide case. Benoit, who was originally booked to face CM Punk for the vacant ECW World Championship, legitimately no-showed.

zh.s: “复仇：冠军之夜”是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）举办的第七届“复仇／冠军之夜”系列付费电视赛事，选手来自Raw、SmackDown!和ECW品牌。赛事由RAW Attitude能量饮料赞助，于2007年6月24日在休斯敦丰田中心举行。所有比赛都以冠军头衔为争夺目标，其中两项冠军易主，七项由原冠军保住。赛事恰逢克里斯·班瓦双重谋杀和自杀案发生的周末。班瓦原定与CM朋克争夺空缺的ECW世界冠军，但他实际上没有出席。

en.t: Republic of the Congo parliamentary election, 2007
en.s: A parliamentary election was held in the Republic of the Congo on 24 June 2007, with a second round initially planned for 22 July 2007, but then postponed to 5 August 2007. According to the National Commission of the Organization of the Elections (CONEL), 1,807 candidates stood in the first round for 137 seats in the National Assembly. The ruling Congolese Labour Party and parties and independent candidates allied with it won 125 seats, while two opposition parties won a combined 12 seats.

zh.s: 刚果共和国于2007年6月24日举行议会选举，原定于7月22日举行的第二轮投票后来推迟至8月5日。根据选举组织全国委员会（CONEL）的数据，第一轮共有1,807名候选人角逐国民议会137个席位。执政的刚果劳动党及其盟友党派和独立候选人共赢得125席，两个反对党合计赢得12席。

en.s: The 2007 CONCACAF Gold Cup final was a soccer match that took place on June 24, 2007, at Soldier Field in Chicago, Illinois, United States, to determine the winner of the 2007 CONCACAF Gold Cup. The United States beat longtime rivals Mexico 2–1 to win the tournament.

en.t: John Isner defeated Nicolas Mahut at the Wimbledon Championships, concluding the longest match in tennis history, which lasted 11 hours and 5 minutes over three days
en.s: From 22 to 24 June 2010, a first-round match at the men's singles tournament of the 2010 Wimbledon Championships was contested between John Isner and Nicolas Mahut. Isner, seeded 23rd, defeated Mahut, a qualifier, 6–4, 3–6, 6–7(7–9), 7–6(7–3), 70–68, in 11 hours and 5 minutes over three days. en.s: Operation Hammer Down was a seven-day U.S.-led assault offensive in June 2011 designed to eliminate foreign fighters and training camps in the Watapur Valley of Kunar Province in Afghanistan in preparation of an eventual push into the Western Pech area. The operation's primary objective was to destroy suspected training camps at the northern end of the Watapur in order to interdict the flow of insurgents through the valley and forbid the Taliban from increasing their manpower in the western Pech.

en.s: Silvio Berlusconi, then the Prime Minister of Italy, was accused and initially convicted of paying 17-year-old Moroccan Karima El Mahroug, also known by the stage name Ruby Rubacuori (Italian for "Ruby the Heartstealer"), for sexual services between February and May 2010 when she was under the age of 18; he was found not guilty on appeal. He was also found not guilty on appeal after having been formerly convicted of malfeasance in office (Italian: concussione) by arranging to have El Mahroug released from police detention during an incident in which she was briefly held on claims of theft. On 24 June 2013, the Court of First Instance sentenced Berlusconi to seven years in prison, and banned him from public office for life.

zh.t: 西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼性交易审判
zh.s: 时任意大利总理的西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼被控向17岁的摩洛哥裔卡里玛·埃尔·马赫鲁格支付性服务费用。她的艺名是Ruby Rubacuori，意大利语意为“偷心的红宝石”；相关指控涉及2010年2月至5月、她未满18岁期间。贝卢斯科尼一审被判有罪，上诉后获判无罪。他还曾因安排警方释放因涉嫌盗窃而短暂被拘留的埃尔·马赫鲁格，被判滥用职权（意大利语：concussione），但上诉后同样获判无罪。2013年6月24日，一审法院判处贝卢斯科尼七年监禁，并终身禁止他担任公职。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Turkey on 24 June 2018 as part of the 2018 general election, alongside parliamentary elections on the same day. en.t: U.S. Supreme Court overturns Roe v. Wade in Dobbs decision
en.s: On June 24, 2022, the U.S. Supreme Court issued its ruling in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization. The majority held that the U.S. Constitution does not confer a right to abortion and overturned its earlier Roe v. Wade and Planned Parenthood v. Casey precedents. The decision returned authority over abortion law to elected lawmakers, allowing states to set their own restrictions.
en.n: June 24 is the Dobbs decision date; Roe was decided in 1973 and Casey in 1992.

zh.t: 美国最高法院在“多布斯案”中推翻“罗诉韦德案”判例
zh.s: 2022年6月24日，美国最高法院就“多布斯诉杰克逊妇女健康组织案”作出判决。多数大法官认为，美国宪法并未赋予堕胎权，因而推翻了此前“罗诉韦德案”和“计划生育组织诉凯西案”两项判例。此后，堕胎法规重新由民选立法机构制定，各州可以设立自己的限制。
zh.n: 6月24日是“多布斯案”判决日；“罗案”与“凯西案”分别判于1973年和1992年。

en.s: General elections were held in Sierra Leone on 24 June 2023 to elect the president and members of Parliament. Incumbent president Julius Maada Bio was re-elected with 56% of the vote and the Sierra Leone People's Party won 81 seats in Parliament compared to the main opposition party, the All People's Congress, which won 54 seats. The result was contested by the All People's Congress, which demanded a rerun, citing "glaring irregularities".

en.t: Wagner forces seize Rostov-on-Don and advance toward Moscow
en.s: In the early hours of June 24, 2023, Wagner Group fighters entered Russia's Rostov region and seized Rostov-on-Don, including the Southern Military District headquarters. They then advanced north toward Moscow during a brief armed rebellion led by Yevgeny Prigozhin. Later that day, Prigozhin called off the advance after a negotiated agreement. The rebellion itself had begun on June 23.

The election was won by Conservative Party candidate Don Stewart, making him the first Conservative MP since 1993 to represent the riding.

zh.t: 2024年多伦多—圣保罗联邦选区补选
zh.s: 加拿大安大略省多伦多—圣保罗联邦选区于2024年6月24日举行补选，起因是自由党现任议员卡罗琳·贝内特辞职。有人将这场选举视为对总理贾斯廷·特鲁多执政表现的公投。保守党候选人唐·斯图尔特获胜，使保守党自1993年以来首次在该选区赢得议席。

en.t: 2025 New York City Democratic mayoral primary
en.s: The Democratic Party primary for the 2025 New York City mayoral election took place on June 24, 2025. Voters ranked up to five candidates using ranked-choice voting. The early voting period began on June 14. Incumbent mayor Eric Adams did not run in the primary, instead choosing to compete for re-election as an independent in the general contest, though he later dropped out.
